name: Peckerwoods
description: Peckerwoods is not a single unified gang but a name used by various white supremacist prison gangs and street gangs across multiple states. The subculture originated in California and Texas prison systems and is most prevalent there and across the West and South. Individual Peckerwood-affiliated groups have also been documented in states including Nebraska, Nevada, New Mexico, Connecticut, Minnesota, and Missouri. Some prison systems use 'Peckerwood' as a generic category for white supremacist inmates rather than referring to a single cohesive organization.
